description: This file contains utility functions for string formatting, including converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI for consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and collapsing multiple whitespace.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, handling accented characters and delimiters.
